get_chrome_debug_candidates: get a list of installed Chrome-like browser paths for a given operating system
chrome_debug_data_dir: get the file system path to the Chrome debug user data directory
manual_chrome_debug_command: generate a shell command string to launch Chrome with remote debugging on a given port
try_launch_chrome_debug: launch Chrome in headless debug mode on a specified CDP port and return success status
chrome_debug_args: get the list of Chrome CLI arguments needed to enable remote debugging on a port
